name: sense
description: Keep one private, user-controlled work profile available across AI tools.

interface.shortDescription: Keep your work profile available across AI tools
interface.longDescription: Sense keeps collaboration preferences and durable lessons in one private profile that the user can review and revise. AI tools can use the same profile across different work, while project facts stay with their projects and source-specific context stays in Corpus. The profile remains on this Mac across plugin updates.
defaultPrompt: Show me the work profile you use when collaborating with me.
Use Sense to work with me on this task.
Show what Sense currently carries forward from completed work.
